pages.notes: All ten contents entries viewed; roadmap lists ASR/chatbot evolution/Turing/rule/retrieval/generative/LLMs/assistant/limitations/emotional intelligence.

ASR ear versus conversational AI brain analogy actually viewed. ASR waveform→text; conversational system extracts intent and response with NLP. Phoneme decomposition is presented as if universal but modern direct systems need not expose phoneme stages. Avoid literal cognitive or consciousness claims.

Full five-event timeline viewed: ELIZA1964 rule-based; ALICE late1990s/2000s labeled retrieval; commercial assistants2010s; Transformers2017; ChatGPT era2022+. Wording scaled up drawbacks to include context memory. Treat broad lecture associations, not exact invention chronology; ALICE pattern matching must not be conflated with dense semantic vector retrieval.

All Turing Test bullets and diagram viewed. Human judge exchanges text with hidden human and hidden AI; distinguishability criterion;1950 attribution. Behavioral test does not establish internal understanding or emotions. This is a simplified test description, not a rigorous numerical pass-rate protocol.

Definition, four family examples and weather input/output schematic viewed. Chatbot communication layer between people/robot can use text/speech; understanding/generation are intended functions, not a guarantee all systems do them correctly. ELIZA/ALICE/ChatGPT and commercial assistant names presented as examples.

Rule-based bullets and entire yes/no flow viewed. UserInput→PatternMatching→RuleFound? yesReturnResponse/noSorryIdidnotgetyou. Exact hello IF–THEN response. Fixed developer rules/no data learning describes pure fixed rules; broad unsuitable for modern robots/no context/no unseen questions overclaim because rules can carry state/wildcards and constrained tasks.

ELIZA history, swappable script architecture and screen dialogue read. User I hate cats → You say you hate cats?; Yes → You seem to be quite positive. Therapy is a script rather than hardcoded core.1964 and no memory beyond immediate statement require original-source check; original MEMORY facility may be relevant, not modern coherent context.

All six central boxes and five callouts viewed. Tokenization→Preprocessing(Standardization)→KeywordExtraction→DecompositionPatterns→ReassemblyRules→PostProcessing. Actual normalization cant→can't; keywords sorry/Iam, priority says script order; wildcard *i am*; random template selection; final I→you. Historical original priority/rule-selection may differ; distinguish this simplified schematic from original implementation.

Five-box vector retrieval diagram and text viewed: UserQuery→ConvertQueryintoVector→SimilaritySearch→RetrieveBestMatchingResponse→ReturnResponse. Similar rather than exact question; fixed response bank limits novelty. Embedding proximity model dependent; not every retrieval system uses vectors. No distances/threshold/numerical coordinates supplied.

ALICE expansion and all text viewed: Artificial Linguist Internet Computer Entity; database phrases, pre/post substitutions, keywords and response patterns, broader subjects. Open-source/current-use prose time dependent; pattern-rule architecture not automatically the preceding dense-vector similarity pipeline.

AIML expansion Artificial Intelligence Markup Language, XML foundation and category/pattern/template/think tags viewed. Category is the basic unit; pattern is the input trigger; template supplies the response; think hides evaluated variable/context operations. Think suppresses rendered output; setters perform state change.

Full code and prose viewed. Input I play my guitar.; pattern I PLAY *; template Is <set_it><person/></set_it> a game or a musical instrument? Wildcard captures my guitar; supplied person substitution gives your guitar. Legacy-style set_it both returns its value inside the visible reply and stores it under the explicitly supplied semantics. The prose saying quietly saves does not imply the enclosing visible response is suppressed. Runtime and normalization are unspecified.

Full code viewed. Input I read Sci-fi books.; pattern I READ * BOOKS; visible Name some books in that genre. Hidden nested set_it/set_does/settopic stores read <person/> books, and a second think sets personality to critical. Case of Sci-fi varies in prose. All five legacy-style setters need explicit semantics rather than being silently changed to modern AIML. Predictability and developer approval do not establish safety for all wildcard input or robot actions.

All prose and User Input to Generative AI Model to response diagram viewed. Generative models compose output token by token, including word or subword tokens; most probable is a greedy decoding description, not every possible decoding policy. Context is finite rather than an unlimited memory guarantee.

Every code line and hyperlink viewed. Imports gradio and AutoTokenizer/AutoModelForCausalLM/pipeline; unspecified model_id and question; text-generation pipeline; literal user/assistant marker prompt; output[0][generated_text]; top-level return reply. Slide explicitly calls this simplified code, so missing function/interface scaffolding is an omission, not evidence the actual notebook fails. Default full-text return may retain prompt; role markers depend on model. PDF hyperlink verified as the official robotics-lab-iitr/nptel-ai-robotics repository.

All sequential boxes and online/offline examples viewed. Offline Whisper to Ollama/Llama 3 to Piper; online Google Cloud STT to OpenAI API GPT to Google Cloud TTS. Ollama is a runtime, Llama a model. Text bottleneck can lose acoustic cues; delays and upstream errors can propagate. Offline/online are example stacks, not mandatory all-or-none deployment.

All numbered steps viewed: local wake word, cloud audio/STT, NLP intent, action or predefined response, TTS. Slide broadly labels named assistants retrieval systems with minimal context. Treat as a simplified historical architecture, not an exhaustive current product claim. Software versus physical action distinction is contextual; software assistants can invoke connected physical devices.

Actual figure shows continuously listening robot and activated Hello robot; text names Raspberry Pi and Jetson Orin Nano as edge examples. Local wake-word monitoring precedes cloud or local full STT. Not recording anything is ambiguous: monitoring still samples/processes audio, while durable recording and upload are separate choices.

All figure arrows traced: user to STT to Intent Parsing to LLM; LLM branches to TTS back to user and ROS State Machine to Robot Action. Yellow boxes sequential; blue branches may run concurrently. Diagram does not establish zero latency, safe motion, exact scheduling or executable validation. Lower text ends with instant physical Robot Action.

All four prose commands and three speech bubbles viewed. Clean up this room, Pick up the toys, Put those away converge on Execute Clean-up Program. This is a supplied task mapping, not universal synonymy: scope and referents can differ.

Text examples retain pick toys and clean room. Figure striking out Could you please, up, all the leaves pick/toys, although up is printed bold under strike. Unique keywords cannot guarantee correct intent if negation, object reference or scope is discarded. Robot speech and action are distinct downstream outputs.

Three flaws viewed: lost pitch/timbre/tonality/emotion cues, sequential latency, ASR errors propagating. SpeechLMs can process/generate speech without a mandatory transcript bottleneck. End-to-end does not guarantee zero error, zero delay, or universal full duplex.

Every component and multimodal arrow viewed. Speech tokenizer maps waveform to discrete or continuous tokens; transformer autoregressively predicts next speech token; vocoder returns waveform. Figure also shows text input/output paths and cross-modal arrows. Input The quick brown fox jumps over and output the lazy dog. are continuations; transcript captions explain content, not necessarily mandatory internal ASR.

All bullets viewed: semantic tokens favor content but lose acoustic detail; acoustic tokens preserve fidelity but may struggle with content; mixed tokens balance goals. Full duplex permits listening during speech and interruption handling in suitably designed systems. OpenAI Realtime named only as source example. Preserved cues do not guarantee correct intent/emotion inference.

All three bullets viewed: loss of how speech was said, internal affective states, dynamic simulated personality. No way to infer is too strong if interpreted universally: hidden states are not directly measured, but observations may support uncertain inference. Simulated responses do not by themselves establish subjective feelings.

All five bullets viewed. Facial motion and speech patterns are observable cues used for pattern recognition; emotion engine combines modalities. Recognize reasonably well and cannot truly understand are broad evaluative claims, not supplied metrics or operational definitions. Questions will test external evidence and uncertainty, not assert a consciousness theorem.

All summary bullets inspected. Repeats rule/retrieval/generation evolution, intent/context, SpeechLM shift, full duplex and affective cues; no new code or numerical premise. Existing qualifications on historical scope and guarantees carry forward.
